insight: Built on plain Postgres, so there's no proprietary lock-in — and the same project ships the Supabase MCP server also listed here.
name: Supabase
tagline: Postgres + auth + storage + edge functions, open source.
description: A common default backend when an app needs persistence + auth + realtime. Open-source, self-hostable, very low friction to local dev with the CLI.
edge: Plain Postgres as the backend — open source and self-hostable, so no proprietary data lock-in.
pros: Built on standard Postgres, no lock-in
Auth, storage, realtime, edge funcs bundled
Generous free tier and fast local dev
cons: Postgres knowledge needed for advanced use
